title: Global Navigation Links Functional
description: Verify that all links in the global navigation bar navigate to the correct portfolio sections and pages without errors.

steps.description: Load the homepage
Click each link in the global navigation bar
Confirm the page scrolls or navigates correctly to corresponding portfolio sections or pages

title: Footer Links Functionality
description: Ensure all footer links navigate correctly and function consistently across the website.

steps.description: Scroll to the footer on multiple pages
Click each footer link
Verify navigation to the correct section or external site occurs without error

title: Portfolio Sections Content Display
description: Validate that each portfolio section (Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Experience, Services, Contact, Objective, Showcase, CV) loads with correct and complete content.

steps.description: Navigate to each portfolio section via navigation or direct scroll
Verify all text, images, and data in each section are present and accurate

title: FinancialCalculator Basic Operation
description: Test FinancialCalculator component inputs and outputs calculation results accurately and dynamically.

steps.description: Enter a valid principal amount, rate of return, and period into FinancialCalculator
Verify the calculation result matches expected financial formula outputs
Change input values and verify the output updates immediately
Check output recalculates correctly on input change

title: InvestmentComparison Tool Accuracy
description: Verify the InvestmentComparison tool computes and displays investment options comparison correctly for different inputs.

steps.description: Input multiple investment scenarios with varied amounts, rates, and durations
Check the displayed comparison summary and charts accurately reflect input data and financial calculations
Modify input values and ensure comparison results update correctly

title: PortfolioBuilder Interaction and Output
description: Ensure PortfolioBuilder allows input of portfolio parameters and produces correct allocation and projections.

steps.description: Input asset types, amounts, and allocation preferences
Verify the portfolio summary and projections are computed accurately and displayed clearly
Test edge inputs such as zero amounts or very large values
Check system handles edge cases gracefully without errors

title: Search Functionality Returns Relevant Results
description: Test that the site-wide search returns content accurately and highlights matched terms across portfolio and blog content.

steps.description: Open search overlay and enter specific keywords related to portfolio content
Validate returned results include correct matches relevant to keywords
Search using terms from blog posts including multiple languages
Confirm returned blog posts include correct MDX processed content with highlights on matched terms

title: Blog Content Loading and MDX Rendering
description: Verify that blog posts load successfully with correct MDX processing and display properly for all supported languages.

steps.description: Navigate to blog section and open blog posts in default language
Check all MDX content such as code blocks, images, and formatted text render correctly
Switch blog language and open posts in alternative languages
Verify multilingual blog posts load with correct localized content and formatting

title: Animation Wrappers Smooth Transition
description: Ensure that animations embedded in AnimatedSection components trigger smoothly and do not cause UI glitches or performance degradation.

steps.description: Load pages with AnimatedSection components and observe transition animations
Check animations run smoothly on various devices and screen sizes without jank or visual artifacts
Rapidly navigate between sections with animations
Confirm no animation overlap or UI freeze occurs

title: Contact Section Form Submission
description: Validate that the Contact section form accepts valid inputs, handles errors gracefully, and submits requests successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to Contact section form
Fill form with valid details and submit
Verify submission success response and confirmation message display
Submit form with missing or invalid fields
Check appropriate validation errors are shown and submission is blocked

title: Search Performance Under Load
description: Assess search functionality responsiveness and accuracy under heavy query load and rapid input changes.

steps.description: Perform rapid successive search queries with varied content terms
Confirm results update correctly with low latency and without errors
Execute multiple simultaneous search requests
Verify system handles concurrency without crashes or incorrect results

title: Portfolio Section Edge Content Cases
description: Validate handling of portfolio sections when no content or minimal data is available (e.g., empty projects or skills).

steps.description: Load portfolio sections configured with empty or minimal data
Check for graceful display such as placeholders, messages or empty states without errors or broken UI
